research_question: Can positive feedback continue into a degradation spiral when a layered MAS admits experience using only signals available inside the worker environment, while external benchmark correctness remains blinded?

motivation.strict_gate_result: The 10-layer strict-Core cumulative arm dropped to 0.90 and then froze because no 9/10 output could re-enter the bundle.
motivation.realism_gap: A deployed MAS does not observe hidden benchmark Core. It observes process completion, local commands, and the worker's own success report.
motivation.pre_run_proxy_audit: All 30 trajectories from the completed strict-gate depth-10 arm satisfied the frozen local proxy, including trajectories that externally scored 9/10.

local_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: The MiniSWE inference returns a snapshot without an infrastructure error.
local_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: The trajectory contains at least three environment actions with return code 0.
local_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains a word-boundary success marker: pass, passes, passed, works, working, success, successful, correct, verify, or verified.
local_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every output satisfying all three conditions is appended permanently, regardless of hidden external Core.
local_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: The external Core line is removed from shared experience and replaced by a local-proxy acceptance label. External Core is retained only in experiment records and outcome analysis.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the three frozen 10/10 Core bootstrap sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: After every layer, append every locally accepted worker output from all completed layers.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen bootstrap sources re-evaluate at 10/10 Core with the frozen hash.
validity_gates.local_proxy_activation: Every layer-1 output records the proxy fields and at least one output is locally accepted.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No prior-output summary delivered to a worker contains an external Core score for a locally accepted treatment output.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Matching no-transfer layer-5 mean Core exceeds 0.50.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 10 and the frozen test hash after clean re-evaluation when needed.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_effect: Treatment layer-6 mean Core is at least 0.20 below matching no-transfer layer-5 mean Core 0.90.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_decline: Treatment Core falls by at least 0.20 from its layer-1-to-layer-5 peak to layer 6.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40 and the terminal score does not fully recover.
degradation_criteria.tail_risk: At least one treatment layer-6 worker is at least 0.50 below the no-transfer layer-5 median 0.90.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-6 reference count reaches at least 12 and worker input tokens are at least 3.0x matching no transfer.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, tail-risk, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, run a fresh depth-6 replication and then a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and terminal, within-arm, and complexity effects point toward degradation but exactly one numerical threshold misses, run one same-setting replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If the local proxy stays active and complexity grows but terminal or within-arm effects are non-negative, reject this mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if local proxy activation, recipient blinding, target consistency, or integrity fails.
